links.outcome: Review and drafting time with vs without AI drafts; perceived clinical efficiency
links.effect: Review and drafting times were similar for users with and without Art; perceived clinical efficiency declined significantly PRE to POST-2; well-being unchanged.
links.quote: Review and drafting times were similar for users with and without Art, indicating minimal differences.

unlisted_practices: Hybrid type 1 effectiveness-implementation evaluation of an AI drafting tool
Thematic analysis of barriers and facilitators using the NASSS framework
Consensus on quality indicators and thresholds for GenAI robustness

screen.reason: Empirical implementation study of an LLM-based draft response system (Epic Art) in actual clinical workflow; it evaluates implementation and effectiveness of the AI tool itself rather than testing a specific safeguard or deployment practice comparative intervention.
